title: Badal
desc: Badal witnesses his family being massacred during a riot in his village. He is raised by a terrorist and soon sets out to exact revenge on the police officer responsible for his family's murder.

title: Kabir Singh
desc: An exalted but short-fused surgeon plunges into a spiral of drugs, alcohol and rage after his intense relationship with his girlfriend turbulently ends.

title: Tirangaa
desc: An elite spy with the Research and Analysis Wing grapples with her heart in a race against time as she embarks on a dangerous mission to take out a deadly terrorist in the Middle East.
